items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Al Streiman. Al Streiman. He died recently, last month. When, when years was, what years was he functioning? Do you remember? [INTERVIEWEE] All the time I was.

ctx.x: Jimmy Gable, he died. His name was, his name was really James, uh, Ginsburg. James at the Gable, he had the jacks program. He's, he played trumpet with me quite a bit. He's a fine trumpet player. He's a college man. He got good students.
Al Streiman. Al Streiman. He died recently, last month. When, when years was, what years was he functioning? Do you remember?

All the time I was. All the time? And before I went into the Spartan game, I had to break into a bunch of established bands when I started playing sorority and fraternity dances. I had just proved my way. Of course, I had a couple of people who, who liked me and they flogged me. And I did the same. I, I put Russ Papaya in business and gave him music. Because when I had a junk roof, they didn't want any prom on it. And I couldn't give up the job because they didn't want him.
